Hi Lydia —

Thanks again for the time today. Great to hear more about AcmeHealth's roadmap for embedding summarization and notes generation into the clinician workflow. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Key goals you mentioned: reduce clinician documentation time by ~30%, keep latency under 250ms p50 for short summaries, and support on-prem deployment for PHI-sensitive workloads.
- Current blockers: procurement timeline (Q3), security questionnaire in flight, and need for an executive alignment call between our VP/GM and your CTO to confirm deployment model and SLA expectations.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Exec alignment: intro call (VP/CTO) — 30 minutes to confirm approach and org-level constraints.
2) Technical deep dive / demo: 60 minutes with Rishi to walk through latency, batching, and private deployment options.
3) Share a short requirements doc (attached) and a proposed demo agenda.

Proposed times (all PDT):
- Wed 4/17 10:00-11:00 (tech deep dive)
- Wed 4/17 11:30-12:00 (exec intro, can be joined by Marcus)
- Thu 4/18 09:00-10:00 (alternate)

I attached a one-page requirements doc and a calendar invite stub for the demo. If you prefer, happy to coordinate with your EA to find times that work for Daniel as well.

Thanks — can we lock one of those slots?

Best,
